pages.title: Peak Stamina
pages.text: Peak Stamina adds a stamina system for sprinting, jumping, and combat actions. When both mods are installed, Nourished modifies Peak Stamina's attributes in real time based on your $(bold)average nutrition level$() across all six food groups.

pages.title: How It's Calculated
pages.text:
All six nutrition bars are averaged together into a single value. This average drives all stamina modifiers — it is $(bold)not$() per-group. Keeping all six bars healthy is more important than maxing one or two.

$(#52c252)Above 75% average$() — bonuses apply.
$(#E8C24F)25% – 75% average$() — neutral, no modifier.
$(#e05252)Below 25% average$() — penalties apply.

pages.title: Bonuses (avg > 75%)
pages.text:
When your average nutrition is above 75%:

$(#52c252)+25% Stamina Regen$() — stamina recovers significantly faster.
$(#52c252)+10% Max Stamina$() — larger total stamina pool.
$(#52c252)-15% Stamina Usage$() — actions cost less stamina.
$(#52c252)+30% Penalty Decay$() — stamina exhaustion penalties fade faster.

All four bonuses are active simultaneously when the threshold is met.

pages.title: Penalties (avg < 25%)
pages.text:
When your average nutrition drops below 25%:

$(#e05252)-25% Stamina Regen$() — stamina recovers much slower.
$(#e05252)-15% Max Stamina$() — smaller total stamina pool.
$(#e05252)+25% Stamina Usage$() — actions cost more stamina.
$(#e05252)+30% Exhaustion Duration$() — stamina exhaustion lasts longer.

This combination makes low nutrition extremely punishing in combat and exploration.

pages.title: Practical Advice
pages.text:
The 75% bonus threshold means keeping $(bold)all six bars above 75%$() on average — not just one or two at full. A single bar at zero drags the average down significantly.

A player with five bars at 100% and one bar at zero has an average of ~83% — just above the bonus line. Let $(bold)two$() bars hit zero and the average drops to ~67%, losing all bonuses. Keep every bar topped up.
